page.notes: The line-end mark after "actu" and after "Quo", "Pha" and "remissio" is a printed hyphen; "actu-" continues on the next page. "tarft" is uncertain (likely "tanquam"). "pánno" carries an acute accent in the print and may be a printing error. The signature reads "S 2" with a stylised 2. No catchword is printed.
